infra.ov.title: Overview
infra.ov.subtitle: Is everything OK? Each card is one question — a grey lamp means AWOG HAS NOT READ IT (no source yet, or a source you have not pressed read for), not that it is fine.
infra.ov.noProfile: No AWS account pinned. The cards below still work, but a real check needs a profile — open the Accounts tab and pick one.
infra.ov.askHint: Suggested questions — press one and the agent runs it for you
infra.ov.fact.accountNone: Not pinned — the AWS CLI default is used
infra.ov.fact.toolsNone: No aws / terraform / kubectl found — open the Accounts tab for install help
infra.ov.card.website.title: Website
infra.ov.card.website.text: This build cannot read CloudFront/Route53, so AWOG will not claim the site is up. Ask the agent to check it with the CLI.
infra.ov.card.website.ask: Is my website up and responding normally? Please check it with the AWS CLI.
infra.ov.card.errors.title: Errors in the last hour
infra.ov.card.errors.text: Counts log lines matching an error pattern (error / exception / fail) over the last hour. It is billed per GB scanned, so AWOG estimates first and only runs when you press the button.
infra.ov.card.errors.groups: Will check {n} recently used log groups: {groups}
infra.ov.card.errors.noGroups: No log group known yet. Open the Logs tab and pick one once — this card remembers what you use.
infra.ov.card.errors.none: Nothing matched the error pattern in the last {window} ({size} scanned).
infra.ov.card.errors.found: {n} lines matched the error pattern in the last {window} ({size} scanned).
infra.ov.card.servers.title: Servers
infra.ov.card.servers.text: Not read yet. Press Read and AWOG runs `ec2 describe-instances` with the pinned profile — it uses your credentials but is NOT billed per GB, and AWOG never runs it just by opening this screen.
infra.ov.card.servers.measured: EC2 reported {total} servers in this region, {running} running.
infra.ov.card.servers.failed: Read failed — this is NOT 0 servers: {error}
infra.ov.card.servers.downMore: {n} servers are not running: {names} and {rest} more
infra.ov.card.servers.partial: Only one page read (200 rows) — there is more, the number on the card is not the whole account
infra.ov.card.servers.ask: List the EC2 servers in this account and tell me which ones are stopped.
infra.ov.card.cost.title: Cost this month
infra.ov.card.cost.text: No cost source yet. The AWS cost API is billed per request, so AWOG only runs it when you ask — not wired up in this build.
infra.ov.card.cost.ask: How much has this AWS account cost so far this month, grouped by service?
infra.ov.card.tls.title: Certificates & domains
infra.ov.card.tls.text: This build cannot read ACM/Route53. Ask the agent which certificates are close to expiring.
infra.ov.card.tls.ask: Which certificates expire within the next 30 days?
infra.ov.card.deploy.title: Latest deployment
infra.ov.card.deploy.text: This build cannot read Amplify/CI. Ask the agent whether the latest deployment succeeded.
infra.ov.sug.errors: Any errors in the last hour?
infra.ov.sug.cost: How much has AWS cost this month?
infra.ov.sug.tls: Which certificates are close to expiring?
infra.ov.sug.slow: Which service is slowest right now?
